title: WaterColor 384 Red Cedar Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Private pool (18' x 10') with spa in WaterColor. **Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for $60 per day. Pool and sitting spa are heated together. - 4 Adult bike- 6 Seater Low-Speed Vehicle- Excellent Camp District location- Screened-in porches- Newly updated chef's kitchen, laundry, bedrooms, dining/sitting area, family room bar, poolside outdoor space, and mudroom- 3-minute walk to Camp WaterColor, 6-minute walk to Seaside- A short bike ride to the beach- Parking for 1 Vehicle in the driveway- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Wander through WaterColor's gorgeous Camp District and you'll find yourself at the doorstep of a coastal gem. This two-story home blends modern comfort with traditional design. Entering through the front door you'll find hardwood floors throughout the house, 10-foot box beam ceilings, and a dining area for 8 with a new sitting room. The kitchen features granite countertops, designer cabinets and brand-new stainless-steel appliances, including a dual fuel range. The kitchen island makes the perfect setting for conversation with friends and family while dinner is prepared! Across from the kitchen you'll find a convenient laundry room spacious enough for all your provisions. The kitchen offers seating for 3 at the counter. The kitchen opens onto the living room which features new furniture and a 50-inch smart television. A hardwood staircase leads to the second story where you'll find the newly updated primary bedroom with king bed, a private secluded screened patio, 32-inch flat-screen smart television, and an ensuite bath with shower. The second-floor guest bedroom has a king bed, 27-inch flat-screen television, and a private bath with a shower. An additional second guest bedroom offers two built-in twin over twin bunk beds, a 32-inch flat-screen television, and a shared bath with a shower. Adjacent is a cozy sleeping nook with a twin bunk bed - the perfect place for the youngsters. Serene outdoor spaces set this WaterColor home apart. It features screened-in porch, newly installed pool with super jetted sitting spa and outdoor dining area with a propane gas grill, making it the perfect place to watch for local fauna. This 3-bedroom plus bunk nook, 3.5-bath coastal getaway offers accommodations for up to 8 guests. Reserve this WaterColor gem today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:SECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTwin Nook: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.**Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, golf cart rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
